topics.passage:
Tara's Rainbow (original story on the chapter's theme)
It rained all morning. When the rain stopped, Tara ran outside and looked up.
'Where is the rainbow?' she asked. The sky was grey. There was no rainbow.
Tara went inside and picked up her crayons.
On the big white wall of her room, she drew a rainbow: red like a tomato, orange, yellow like a banana,
green like a leaf, blue like the sky, indigo, and violet like a brinjal.
'Now I have my own rainbow!' said Tara.
Her little brother Chotu came running. He took the pink crayon and drew a pink kite in the sky, flying over the rainbow.
Tara and Chotu clapped. It was the happiest wall in the house.
